answer: What survives to the quill is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the fable.
